question: The author of the novel ‘The Ministry of Utmost Happiness’ is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Arundhati Roy__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Arundhati Roy is a **Political Activist and Writer**.
 
• Her debut Novel is the "**God Of Small Particle Things"** has won the **Booker Prize**** **in **1997**.
 
• The Novel depicts **Corruption, Political Violence, and Capitalism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kiran Desai**

 
 
• **​**She is a famous English author of **Indian Origin**.
 
• Her notable literary work, **The Inheritance Of Loss** won the **2006 Man Booker Prize**.
 
• She was also awarded the **National Book Critics Circle Fiction Award.**
 
 
 
• **Vikram Seth**
 
 
• Vikram Seth is a renowned Indian author and poet.
 
• He has given many contributions to literature like **A Suitable Boy, The Golden Gate, and An Equal Music**.
 
• He was awarded by **Padma Shri, Sahitya Academy, and Commonwealth Writers Prize**.
 
 
 
• **VS Naipaul**
 
 
• **​**He was a famous English Writer, born in **Trinidad**.
 
• His notable literary works are **A House for Mr. Biswas, In a Free State, and A Blend in the River**.
 
• He won **The Nobel Prize **in literature in **2001 **for **Half-A-Life**.
